title: The secret of happiness
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Do you think happiness depends more on circumstances or on how people interpret their lives?
Why can people achieve something they wanted for years and still not feel happy?
Is it possible to pursue happiness too aggressively?
Which gives longer-lasting happiness: experiences, relationships, achievements, or possessions?
If you had to remove one source of unnecessary unhappiness from modern life, what would it be?
